fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Aramco recorded Q3 net income of $36.3 billion, up 35%, with adjusted net income (excluding the sale of stake in Malaysian refining and petrochemical company) up 9% to $31.2 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Oil prices averaged $95.20 per barrel, up from $70.10 year-over-year, and the company benefited from oil price surge due to supply disruption and uncertainty following the Iran war outbreak.
fields.summary_ko.2: Despite tanker shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, the company continued oil exports through the East-West Pipeline and US-protected corridor.
